title: Iron ions lose 4s before 3d
caption: Although 4s fills before 3d, once 3d is occupied the 4s electrons are the outermost and are removed first. Fe²⁺ is [Ar] 3d⁶ and Fe³⁺ is [Ar] 3d⁵, a half-filled sub-shell.
alt: Box diagrams for Fe, [Ar] 3d⁶ 4s²; Fe²⁺, [Ar] 3d⁶ with 4s empty; Fe³⁺, [Ar] 3d⁵.
description: Fe³⁺: one 3d electron removed as well, leaving five single 3d electrons.
